description: Disconnect an app you connected by signing in: its sign-in stops working at once, and it must ask you to sign in again to come back. Pass an id from list_connected_apps. A connection with less than full access can disconnect only itself; the dashboard can disconnect any, under Profile, Sessions, Connected apps. Cannot be undone. Needs a credential that names a person: signing in to Last Price from this MCP client, or a person token. An API key names a workspace, not a person, and gets 403. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

connected_app_id.description: The connected app's id: id on a list_connected_apps result.

name: disconnect_connected_app
